bundle.shortDescription: Ambient edge glow, synced lyrics and a living desktop scene for your music.
bundle.longDescription: Glowtune follows whatever music is playing on your PC and lights up your screen edges in the album's colors, shows synced lyrics, and turns your desktop into a live music scene. Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music and SoundCloud can play inside Glowtune without ads. Everything stays on your PC.
